title: Dragon Venom Extraction & Containment Breach
description: You are a xenochemist tasked with extracting luminous venom from a captive crystalline dragon specimen behind a reinforced glass containment window. As you manipulate extraction parameters, the corrosive venom risks shattering the containment glass, requiring you to balance extraction rate, temperature, and neutralization agents across multiple steps to safely collect the sample.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap/CDN) implementing an interactive chemistry lab scene. Load DragonAttenuation.glb as a dragon specimen positioned on a raised platform at center-back of the scene, and GlassBrokenWindow.glb as a containment barrier placed between the camera and the dragon, acting as a lab safety window. Camera: perspective at (0, 1.5, 4) looking toward the dragon. Lighting: cool ambient light (0x334466), a green-tinted point light near the dragon simulating bioluminescent venom glow, and a warm directional light overhead simulating lab fluorescents. Create an HTML/CSS overlay panel with these sequential interaction steps: (1) A 'Power On Extractor' toggle button that activates a pulsing green emissive glow on the dragon model. (2) A temperature slider (200K-800K) that changes the point light color from blue to orange, with valid range 350K-550K required. (3) A 'Venom Flow Rate' slider (1-10 mL/s) where values above 7 trigger a screen-shake warning. (4) A dropdown to select neutralization agent (Sodium Bicarbonate, Liquid Nitrogen, Argon Gas) where only Liquid Nitrogen is correct. (5) A 'Begin Extraction' button that, if parameters are valid, animates green particles flowing from the dragon toward a virtual collection vial using a simple particle system. (6) If any parameter is invalid at extraction, animate the GlassBrokenWindow model cracking: scale it slightly, apply a red emissive flash, and shake the camera. (7) A 'Seal Sample' button that finalizes collection, fading particles and displaying a success banner. Validate all parameters before allowing step 5. Show a status log div that records each action with timestamps. Use OrbitControls locked to a limited arc. Add subtle dragon idle animation by oscillating its Y rotation. All models should cast and receive shadows with a ground plane beneath.
